key_insight: SCSB replaces uniform bagging weights with a sparse probability distribution on the simplex, using OOB loss minimization plus a concave quadratic penalty to prune weak ensemble members and improve calibration.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a model-agnostic post-training compression path for bagged ensembles that can cut inference cost substantially while maintaining or improving accuracy and probabilistic reliability.
method: Optimize ensemble weights on the probability simplex using out-of-bag loss.
Replace ineffective L1 sparsity on the simplex with a concave quadratic penalty.
Prune low-weight estimators to form a sparse, calibrated bagging posterior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 96% ensemble compression with linear inference speedups and lower Expected Calibration Error while preserving or improving generalization accuracy.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of OOB estimates and optimization stability, so highly correlated or small ensembles may make the sparse weighting less reliable.
paper_title: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging: Transitioning from Uniform Priors to Sparse Posteriors in Ensemble Learning
